[SWS_DM_02049] Reporting control of dtc failed to IdsM
Upstream requirements:
RS_Ids_00810
⌈
If a diagnostic service ControlDTCSetting is received, which re-
sults in a negative response, the DM shall report a security event
SEV_UDS_CONTROL_DTC_SETTING_FAILED to IdsM (see [26] and table
[SWS_DM_02050]) with the context data given in [SWS_DM_02050].
⌋
[SWS_DM_02050] Security event context data definition: SEV_UDS_CONTROL_
DTC_SETTING_FAILED
